whyTravel.title: Why travel with Mapi Travels?
whyTravel.subtitle: Our track record and commitment make us the best choice to discover Peru.

trust.title: Trust in every journey
trust.desc: Our experience as an authorized agency ensures that every tourism service is delivered exactly as promised. From booking to the end of the trip, we accompany every step with transparency and professionalism.

reputation.title: Internationally recognized reputation
reputation.desc: Thousands of travelers and official awards support our track record. Each tour reflects the prestige we have built, being recommended and recognized by national and international institutions.

satisfaction.title: Satisfaction in every experience
satisfaction.desc: We design authentic itineraries that exceed expectations. Our tourism services are designed to leave unforgettable memories and the certainty of having experienced the best of Peru.

impact.title: Responsible impact and community
impact.desc: Our tours integrate sustainable practices that protect Peru's cultural and natural heritage. By working with local suppliers and communities, we generate authentic experiences that add value to the destination and the traveler.

meta.title: About Us - Mapi Travels
meta.description: Learn about the history, mission and team of Mapi Travels. Authorized agency specialized in tours to Machu Picchu and all of Peru.

hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Connecting hearts with authentic Peru
hero.description: Since 2012, we are the trusted agency that transforms trips into unforgettable experiences, sharing the magic and culture of Peru with travelers from around the world.

missionVision.title: Our Essence
missionVision.subtitle: The values that define us and guide every step of our journey

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To provide exceptional tourism experiences that connect travelers from around the world with Peru's cultural, historical, and natural wealth, promoting responsible and sustainable tourism.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be the leading travel agency in Peru, internationally recognized for excellence in our services, authenticity of our experiences, and commitment to sustainable tourism development.

values.title: Values
values.description: Integrity, respect for local culture, commitment to excellence, environmental responsibility, and passion for showing the best of Peru to every traveler who trusts us.

stats.subtitle: Numbers that reflect years of dedication and excellence

certifications.subtitle: Backed by the most important institutions of Peruvian tourism
certifications.description: We have all the necessary authorizations and certifications to operate as a travel agency and tour operator in Peru, guaranteeing the safety and quality of our services.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.qSeason: When is the best time for this tour?
faq.qAltitude: Do I need to acclimatise to the altitude?
faq.aAltitude: The route stays around {alt} m above sea level. If you are coming from the coast, it is usual to spend a day or two acclimatising first: walk slowly, drink plenty of water and leave the alcohol for later. Tell us your itinerary and we will adjust the pace of the first day.
faq.aIncludedIntro: The price of {price} per person covers:
faq.aIncludedNone: Write to us and we will break down exactly what the {price} per person covers for the dates you have in mind.
faq.qGroup: How many people will I share the tour with?
faq.aGroup: We work in small groups of up to 12 people so the guide can look after everyone. If you would rather have a private service, tell us when booking and we will quote it separately.
faq.qBooking: How do I confirm the booking and when do I pay?
faq.qDuration: How long is it and how is it structured?
faq.aDuration: The experience lasts {duration}. The «Tour plan» tab breaks down what happens in each stage.

journey.title: From the first message to the first footprint
journey.lead: We are with you from the moment you pick a date until you get home: route, permits, transfers and a local guide who knows the ground.

credentials.title: Licensed and registered
credentials.lead: We operate with the tourism-sector permits required by the Peruvian State.
